name: Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS
description: Text-to-speech preview model for fast, controllable high-fidelity speech synthesis, positioned for real-time assistants, high-volume narration, and conversational use cases that need fine-grained control over voice style and pacing.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS model page

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.notes: Recommended replacements are gemini-3.8-flash-tts or gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts. No shutdown date announced.
